## Pairwise dissimilarity

Calculate pairwise dissimilarities

```{r}
TASVEG_first <- filter(TASVEG_clean, round == 1)
TASVEG_revised <- filter(TASVEG_clean, round == 2)
pd1 <- pairwise_dissimilarity(TASVEG_first)
pd2 <- pairwise_dissimilarity(TASVEG_revised)
```

## Pairwise expert distances for each unit.
```{r}
#| eval: true

dis1 <- summary_disagreement(pd1)
dis2 <- summary_disagreement(pd2)
```


## Visualising

This source unit had the highest dissimilarity:


```{r}
#| eval: true
dis_both <- dis1 |>
  left_join(dis2, by = "VEGCODE") |>
  mutate(oo = rank(mean_dissimilarity.x + mean_dissimilarity.y))
ggplot(dis_both) +
  geom_point(aes(
    x = mean_dissimilarity.x,
    y = mean_dissimilarity.y,
    size = (n_pairs.x + n_pairs.y) / 2
  )) +
  theme_wp3()
```


```{r}
#| eval: true

ggplot(dis_both) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = oo,
      y = mean_dissimilarity.x,
      colour = "First"
    )
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(
      x = oo,
      y = mean_dissimilarity.x
    ),
    formula = 'y ~ x',
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.75,
    se = TRUE,
    col = "cyan"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = oo,
      y = mean_dissimilarity.y,
      colour = "Revised"
    )
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(
      x = oo,
      y = mean_dissimilarity.y
    ),
    formula = 'y ~ x',
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.75,
    se = TRUE,
    col = "pink"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Combined dissimilarity rank", y = "Mean dissimilarity per round") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Round",
    values = c(First = "slateblue4", Revised = "maroon")
  ) +
  theme_wp3()
```
